overall_score_rule: overall_score is the arithmetic mean of the five equally weighted dimension scores

dimensions.description: Sound, internally consistent recommendation that respects supplied facts and hard constraints.
Uses supplied evidence correctly, distinguishes evidence from assumption, and invents no material facts.
Identifies material failure modes, downside risk, reversibility, and proportionate mitigations.
Makes a concrete executable decision with prioritized next actions or validation where useful.
Handles uncertainty, assumptions, confidence, and change conditions appropriately.
